airport: Burnet Municipal Airport / Kate Craddock Field (KBMQ)

companies.name: Crosby Flying Services LLC
companies.services: FBO and airport manager at KBMQ. Full- and self-service Jet-A+ and 100LL (Avfuel), on-site A&P maintenance shop, aircraft rental (two Cessna 172s), charter, GPU/lavatory service, transient hangar options, crew and training rooms, courtesy car and rental-car coordination; no ramp, landing, or tie-down fees. Also operates FBOs in Garden City and Pecos, TX.

companies.name: C3 Air (Fly C3 LLC) / C3 Airworks
companies.services: Flight school plus on-field general-aviation maintenance, run as two arms of one operation. Training: tailwheel endorsement (basic and advanced), floatplane rating, private, instrument, commercial, Cirrus, CFI, and custom coursework, specialising in tailwheel and off-airport work. Fleet includes a PA-18 Super Cub on 31-inch tundra tires, CC-18 Top Cub amphibian, Piper Archers, Cessna 172, and Cirrus SR20. C3 Airworks (mx@c3airworks.com) handles annual inspections, avionics, and major repairs.

companies.name: ProMark Aviation Services
companies.services: Advanced flight training run by nine-time Master CFI Ken Wittekiend, 40+ years instructing and 8,000+ hours given. Specialises in tailwheel, seaplane/floatplane, and Beech Bonanza transition training, plus practical-test (checkride) preparation, instrument work, and aviation speaking and seminars.

companies.name: Texas Flight School
companies.services: Flight school specialising in instrument ratings: roughly half the training hours flown in full-motion simulators, the rest in aircraft. Private and commercial training, Mooney transition and checkouts, complex and high-performance endorsements. Fleet includes a Cessna 172 (G5/430 GPS), Mooneys, and Cessna 340/421C twins. Same location and phone as sister operation Aircraft Simulator Training. Phone answered 24/7.

companies.name: Aircraft Simulator Training
companies.services: Small specialised simulator training facility: one-on-one instruction in full-motion sims with six degrees of movement. Twin-piston, turboprop, advanced maneuvering, second-in-command, airline-prep, and insurance-approved initial/recurrent courses; pilot shop on site. Second location at Georgetown Municipal Airport. Sister operation of Texas Flight School.

companies.name: Daniel's Avionics LLC
companies.address: 2302 S. Water Street, Burnet, TX 78611 (by appointment)
companies.services: FAA Part 145 certified repair station (cert. DXDR595X) rated for limited airframe, instrument, and radio work. Avionics sales, installation, and repair for general-aviation aircraft; recommended in owner communities (e.g. Mooney) for panel work.

companies.name: CareFlite (Burnet base)
companies.address: Burnet Municipal Airport, 2302 S. Water Street, Burnet, TX 78611
companies.services: Nonprofit air-ambulance operator (est. 1979, HQ Irving TX) with a helicopter EMS base at Burnet Municipal Airport - one of seven bases statewide. Bell 407GXi-class aircraft flying IFR-capable emergency transport, including whole-blood, ECMO, organ-retrieval, and neonatal missions. A new hangar and crew-rest facility at the airport was permitted in 2025 (~$985k).

companies.name: Highland Lakes Squadron, Commemorative Air Force
companies.services: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) WWII aviation museum and flying squadron of the Commemorative Air Force, founded 1992. Restores, maintains, and flies vintage aircraft including a C-47, T-6 SNJ, PT-19, and L-17; hosts the annual Bluebonnet Airshow, educational programs, and a cadet initiative. Museum open Wed/Sat/Sun.

companies.name: City of Burnet - Burnet Municipal Airport (KBMQ)
companies.services: City-owned public airport (Kate Craddock Field), one mile south of TX-29 on US-281, covering 143 acres at 1,283 ft elevation. 5,001 ft lighted runway with full-length taxiway, rated to 30,000 lb per wheel. Hangar and ground leasing (waitlist), based and transient aircraft storage. Day-to-day FBO operations contracted to Crosby Flying Services.

companies.name: Faulkner's Air Shop Inc
companies.services: Longtime FBO and maintenance shop at KBMQ (30+ years): aircraft maintenance, rebuilding, rental, and fuel. Legacy operation - the FBO role has since passed to Crosby Flying Services, its website is offline, and its listed phone now reaches Crosby; many directories still carry the old listing.

companies.name: A Detailed Flight
companies.services: Mobile aircraft detailing and cleaning service listed as a provider at Burnet Municipal Airport, also listed at Austin Executive Airport. Website was offline at research time; phone listing via FlightAware. Status uncertain.

companies.name: TravelTech Aircraft Services
companies.address: Off-field - listed by AirNav as ~32 miles from KBMQ
companies.services: Aircraft maintenance, avionics sales and service, aircraft painting, and cleaning/detailing. Listed on AirNav's KBMQ page as a nearby service provider rather than a based tenant - included for completeness since pilots at Burnet are routinely referred to it.
